name: post_payment_intents_intent_capture
description: Capture the funds of an existing uncaptured PaymentIntent when its status is requires_capture; uncaptured PaymentIntents are cancelled a set number of days after they are created (7 by default). (POST /v1/payment_intents/{intent}/capture)

intent.description: The identifier of the PaymentIntent to capture.

amount_to_capture.description: The amount to capture from the PaymentIntent, which must be less than or equal to the original amount. Defaults to the full amount_capturable if it's not provided.
